mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as reduced borrowing costs stimulate corporate investment and consumer spending, with the relationship holding across all monetary policy regimes.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 5-day SPX returns is less than or equal to 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative 5-day returns occur in more than 60% of low-rate instances.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE predicting 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in fewer than 40% of declining UNRATE instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% MoM triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate aggressive Federal Reserve tightening to combat accelerating price pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.0% MoM signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST MoM < -1.0%, or Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) create a powerful positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through combined labor market strength and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * FEDFUNDS) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or positive returns occur in fewer than 50% of instances meeting both conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 3-month moving averages signal broad economic weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced business investment and consumer demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO are below 3mo MA, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as aggressive rate hikes compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM instances, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in tightening cycles is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.0%), an unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market overheating that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of UNRATE < 4.0% instances, or Rank IC for UNRATE in late-cycle periods is below 0.03.
